en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 8. My father (RA) said: `Abd Allah ibn Ja`far al-Himyari said, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of al-Hajjal, on the authority of Tha`labah ibn Maymun, on the authority of `Abd al-A`la ibn A`yun
that I asked Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) whether a person who knows nothing has any responsibility. He (AS) replied, “No.”
